about_the_game:
Catch giant fish in real-time 3D with “Fishing Friends 3D,” the ultimate MULTIPLAYER FISHING GAME from the creators of “The Fishing Club 3D.” Whether you’re a casual angler looking to relax or a seasoned pro aiming to climb the leaderboards, dive into breathtaking 3D waters and reel in the big catch alongside friends worldwide!

🎣 KEY FEATURES

* Realistic 3D Environments – Watch fish swim in lifelike waters. What you see is what you catch!

* True-to-Life Fishing Mechanics – Perfect your timing and technique with authentic angling gameplay.

🔧 UPGRADE & CUSTOMIZE YOUR GEAR

* Level Up Your Rods – Earn Rod Skill points after every catch. Customize your fishing rods to your liking. Finetune your fishing rods on Distance, Max Weight, Reel Speed, Accuracy, Cast Speed, Control, and Power.

* Charge the Reel-in Booster to win your fight even against the strongest fish!

* Customize for Performance – Increase casting distance, weight capacity, reel-in speed, fish control, power, casting speed, and aiming accuracy.

* Catch Legendary Fish – With optimized gear, snag epic fish to win trophies and show off to friends.

🌎 EXPLORE BEAUTIFUL FISHING LOCATIONS

* Pine Creek (First Location) – A hidden gem in the Rocky Mountains, teeming with Bluegill, Crappies, Perch, Smallmouth Bass, Walleyes, Muskies, and multiple trout species.

* Legendary Fish Await – Land “Shadowfin” the legendary perch, “Prismflip” the legendary rainbow trout, “Bloop” the legendary Bluegill, “Bottomfeeder Bob” the legendary lake trout, “Mudslide” the legendary Brown Trout, “Shivers” the legendary crappie, and “Tugger” the legendary Smallmouth Bass.

* Freedom to Roam – Walk along scenic shores and cast from any spot to discover secret hotspots.

* New Locations Coming Soon – Stay tuned for fresh fisheries and exotic destinations to test your angling skills.

🏆 COMPETE & WIN REWARDS

* Target Fish Challenges – Hone your gear setups to conquer unique challenges.

* Join 3-Day Tournaments – Battle rival clubs and reel in your biggest catches to earn top spots.

* Upcoming Competitions – Get ready for King-of-the-Spot events and our brand-new Speed Fishing mode.

👥 SOCIAL FISHING CLUBS

* Create or Join Clubs – Form your own fishing club or team up with friends in existing groups.

* Collaborate & Climb – Tackle club tournaments and work together to rise on the leaderboards.

* Exclusive Events – Unlock special rewards and tournaments available only to club members.

📖 MEET ZAC & PHIL: QUESTS & ADVENTURE

* Meet Angler Zac – Learn the basics of fishing through gripping quests and challenges that reward you with super rare bait.

* Team Up with Phil – Join a treasure hunter and explorer searching for the lost fortunes of a mysterious mountain expedition.

💰 FISH DEALS FOR EXTRA CASH

* Complete Fish Deals – Sell your catches to in-game vendors and earn currency.

* Upgrade Your Setup – Use your cash to buy better rods, reels, lures, and more from the shop.

🚀 MORE FEATURES ON THE HORIZON

* Speed Fishing Tournaments – Race against the clock to catch as many fish as possible.

* King-of-the-Spot Competitions – Claim and defend prime fishing locations against rivals.

* New Fisheries & Legendary Fish – Expand your adventures with upcoming content updates.

DOWNLOAD AND PLAY “FISHING FRIENDS 3D” NOW FOR FREE!

Be among the first to embark on this epic multiplayer fishing journey! Whether you want to relax by serene waters or challenge global anglers in thrilling tournaments, “Fishing Friends 3D” offers the best of both worlds. Join friends, upgrade your gear, and reel in giant fish for bragging rights and big rewards! Download today and start your ultimate 3D angling adventure.
